# Kuailu AI CRM | Target Customers

| Customer Profile | Relevant Need |
| --- | --- |
| Startups and growing businesses | Establish a consistent sales process without relying on spreadsheets and fragmented tools. |
| Mid-sized and enterprise organizations | Connect sales data, teams and related enterprise systems. |
| Sales-led organizations | Improve lead follow-up, opportunity visibility and customer engagement. |
| Cross-border teams | Coordinate customer information and sales activity across regions. |
| Organizations with complex workflows | Configure stages, forms, permissions, reports and integrations around existing operations. |
